data.name: Hidaya
data.gender_notes: Hidaya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'hidayah' meaning 'guidance', 'direction'. In Islamic tradition, Hidaya refers to the guidance and direction provided by Allah. The name Hidaya carries the meaning “Guiding, leading” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hidaya usually hope their child will grow to embody guiding, leading and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hidaya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guiding, leading.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hidaya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: هِدَayah
in_arabic.long_meaning: هِدَayah هي كلمة عربية تعني الهداية والرشاد إلى الصراط المستقيم، وهي من أهم المفاهيم في الإسلام، حيث يُعتبر الهداية نعمة من الله تعالى، ويتكرر مفهوم الهداية في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات، كما أنها تُعتبر من أهم الخصال التي يجب على المسلم أن يتحلي بها في حياته

in_urdu.name: ہدایہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہدایہ کا مطلب ہے راستی کی طرف رہنمائی، اور یہ ایک اہم اسلامی تصور ہے جس کا ذکر قرآن پاک میں بھی کیا گیا ہے، یہ نعمت اللہ کی طرف سے ہوتی ہے، اور مسلم کی زندگی میں ایک اہم خصوصیت ہے

in_hindi.name: हिदाया
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिदाया का अर्थ है सही रास्ते की ओर मार्गदर्शन, और यह एक महत्वपूर्ण इस्लामी अवधारणा है जिसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी किया गया है, यह अल्लाह की ओर से एक उपहार है, और मुसलमान के जीवन में एक महत्वपूर्ण विशेषता है

in_pashto.name: هديهه

It represents the journey towards the divine and the importance of following the righteous path in life. It can also be interpreted as an extension of the Prophet Muhammad's mission to guide people towards the truth.
data.spiritual_significance: Hidaya holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it is believed to be a gift from Allah, guiding human beings on their spiritual journey. It symbolizes the connection between the human soul and the divine, and the importance of seeking and following the truth. The name Hidaya serves as a reminder of Allah's unwavering love, compassion, and guidance, and the importance of staying faithful to that guidance in all aspects of life.
